title: OpenAI’s chief scientist has thoughts on how to limit AI development

quotes.text: Among other things, Amodei called for companies to agree to “common safety standards as well as limits on the rate of unchecked AI progress.”
quotes.for: Context on Dario Amodei's call for limits on unchecked AI progress.

title: OpenAI Chief Scientist Urges Industry Limits on AI Development

quotes.text: Pachocki didn’t specify what the initial limit should be or when it might take effect.
quotes.for: Absence of a specified initial threshold or effective date.

quotes.text: OpenAI Chief Executive Officer Sam Altman endorsed the proposal, calling Pachocki’s essay “the most important thing OpenAI has published in awhile.” He said in a post on X that agreeing to common limits would help ensure “safety and control.”
quotes.for: Sam Altman's endorsement of Pachocki's essay on X.

quotes.text: The proposal comes as the US prepares for renewed debate over AI regulation following Democrats’ sweeping victories in the midterm elections.
quotes.for: U.S. regulatory context following the 2026 midterm elections.

quotes.text: Some lawmakers are also discussing the creation of a dedicated Senate committee to coordinate AI policy.
quotes.for: Discussion of a dedicated Senate committee to coordinate AI policy.

title: Microsoft Puts MAI-2 on OpenAI's Perplexity Chart

quotes.text: In a post on X at 00:37 UTC on November 23, 2026, Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman wrote: “We fully support OpenAI’s transparency initiative.”

quotes.text: Its MAI-2 Base model scores 0.819 log-perplexity on OpenAI’s held-out evaluation set; MAI-1 Base scores 0.878.

title: What affects chain-of-thought monitorability across the model lifecycle?

quotes.text: Lower base-model perplexity and some architectural changes improve no-CoT reasoning, while RL and model-generated data can increase CoT controllability.
quotes.for: Correlation between lower base-model perplexity and stronger no-CoT reasoning.

quotes.text: These are imperfect proxies for monitorability, but together they indicate that models will become harder to monitor through their CoT as we scale toward more intelligent systems.
quotes.for: Finding that scaling makes models harder to monitor through chain of thought.

quotes.text: However, with GPT-6 Astra we observed degradation in CoT monitorability for non-adversarial settings
quotes.for: Observed CoT monitorability degradation in GPT-6 Astra.
